rootCauses.cause: Expected additive DDL carried CRLF from the Windows checkout; SHOW CREATE returned LF. Token-level DDL, collations and metadata agreed.
rootCauses.fix: Normalize only SQL line endings in candidate contract generation/loading; retain exact metadata and token comparisons.

rootCauses.cause: Only institution_email_mutex.id is incompatible with the old classifier: real COLUMN_TYPE=int, DATA_TYPE=int, NOT NULL, PRI, collation NULL. Classifier required int(11).
rootCauses.fix: Allow signed int/int(11) only for this exact singleton column; preserve NOT NULL/PRI and all resource GUID/collation controls.

rootCauses.cause: Historical ACTION_ORDER was JSON string 2; server JSON returned numeric 2.
rootCauses.fix: Derive numeric order in candidate contract only.

rootCauses.cause: New CREATE SQL escapes the absolute-end anchor with two backslashes; ACTION_STATEMENT exposes the parsed single backslash.
rootCauses.fix: Derive expected ACTION_STATEMENT only for generated REGEXP_LIKE absolute-end anchors; never rewrite observed bodies.

rootCauses.cause: Real CHAR(64) assignment stores only 64 As from 64 As plus newline before the trigger; direct ICU predicate on the original 65-character string returns 0. Required DML rejection is not achieved.
rootCauses.fix: No production schema change or permissive test replacement. Failure retained for design/remediation.

rootCauses.cause: 22 canonical FKs omit both actions. The real 8.4.13 metadata returns NO ACTION/NO ACTION; six historical classifiers required RESTRICT.

rootCauses.cause: The immutable fresh schema does not seed the historical MAMP fixture institution used by LegacyBackfillDoesNotRewriteFormativeSnapshots.
rootCauses.fix: Only the owned 8.4 test supplies the explicit synthetic institution, first asserting absent-owner rejection and unchanged snapshots, then asserting backfill preserves snapshots. Full formative suite repeated.
